note: v2192: Two things he called critical. First, the blind state of the stash gate is a per call receipt now instead of a process counter. Every reader used to snapshot the global silent and broke counters before and after a call and treat any movement as this frame was blind, which is correct alone and false in the console, because chronicle and vault sweeps run on other threads and gate their own frames. A sibling thread ticking the counter inside the window answered for a frame it never touched, and in the direction that costs him footage: a tooltip frame, text present and the only place an item name lives on a stash screen, collapses out of the measured no and into the class the prune is allowed to delete. A cross family review called this architectural rather than a bug and it was right, because no care around the delta fixes a counter that belongs to the process. The read now stamps a receipt on a thread local and the three call sites ask that. The run level counters stay, because every frame this sweep probed came back silent is a different and still useful fact about the lane. Proven red by putting the delta back: the guard fails and names the tooltip case. This was the prerequisite blocking the whole auto prune arc. Second, his runeword ruling. Three lists disagree and none of them was right: the farm roster holds 101 because variants are separate rows, the chronicle map holds 97, and he has made 99. The comment beside the board own KPI still claims 99 of 99, a label that outlived its referent when the map drifted to 97. He plays the game and he is the authority, so 99 is a named constant now with the evidence written beside it.
